newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WELSH SQUAD TO FACE TURKEY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WELSH SQUAD TO FACE TURKEY.

text.p: Wales squad to face Turkey in a World Cup group seven qualifier against Turkey on August 20:
Goalkeepers: Neville Southall (Everton), Andy Marriott (Wrexham), Paul Jones (Southampton)
Defenders: Kit Symons (Manchester City), Andy Melville (Sunderland), Robert Page (Watford), Stephen Jenkins (Huddersfield Town), Robert Edwards (Bristol City)

Midfielders: Gary Speed (Everton), John Robinson (Charlton Athletic), Robbie Savage (Leicester City), Ceri Hughes (Wimbledon), Mark Pembridge (Sheffield Wednesday), Clayton Blackmore (Middlesbrough), John Trollope (Derby County), Marcus Browning (Huddersfield Town), Ryan Giggs (Manchester United)
Forwards: Mark Hughes (Chelsea), John Hartson (West Ham), Nathan Blake (Bolton Wanderers), Dean Saunders (Nottingham Forest, Lee Jones (Tranmere Rovers)
